summary: F1 is closed for the published Hy4 candidate. All 16 changed scored IDs had failed at the old due-date locator. Both reference controls score 100. No other change in criterion results or published score defect was established.
nonblocking_findings: F7 [Nit] review-a: TECH-DEBT — harness/tests/e2e/_forms.ts:14-18 does not restrict the label match to a date-capable editable control. A member selector with a matching label could satisfy both E.member-options and E.labels without a due-date input (detail.spec.ts:206-227). A matching control earlier in DOM order can also displace a previously accepted date input. The regex excludes alternative text labels such as Return deadline and Due on when no type or name branch matches. The previous name branch already allowed hidden inputs; visibility prevents those from passing but a hidden match can mask a visible one. Limit the match to an appropriate visible control, test competing controls and missing dates, and accept equivalent labels. No such published candidate was established in the stored form source review.
evidence: HEAD is d695e202077f4e54a7b424469c609812bc0a0416. The phase base is 50aa0e881926e0cb141c38f6931a92234a141af3. The review started at HEAD. The exact phase diff changes 17 files; git diff --check reports no issues. The incremental diff from 23cd701 changes five files.

F1 withdrawn: _forms.ts:14-28 retains all three old selector branches and adds the accessible-label branch. The published Hy4 form has a single Due date label for its nameless text input at checkout-form.tsx:101-112. Its parser accepts a calendar date at lines 24-33 and passes the result to checkoutItem at line 60. The diagnostic copy has the same candidate and protected-fixture hashes. Both earlier reference input forms still score 100.

Q1: Locator.or forms a union and first() selects at most one DOM element. It does not guarantee that a match exists or that the underlying control is unique. Tests at due-date-input.test.ts:5-25,33-38 verify one match and a native value in each isolated case. Text and date receive 2026-04-30; datetime-local receives 2026-04-30T00:00. Both formats express the requested day. The given dueAt check accepts any instant on that UTC day (_forms.ts:69-83).

Q2: E.1 and E.10 specify a due-date input and an accessible name, not the text of that name (fixture spec:50,63-64). The regex is case insensitive and permits spaces or hyphens. F7 records the remaining ambiguity. Checkout submissions additionally require a real fill and store or error assertions (detail.spec.ts:144-187,298-312). A wrongly matched select cannot satisfy fill. The stored form source search did not identify a competing labelled control or an alternate-labelled text input that this change misses.

Q3: The score maps in a-hy4-flash-free-2026w48-r2 and rv-1128-hy4-1 artifacts/score.json:100-180 differ only in 13 criteria and three probes. Criteria false to true: E.error-announced, E.error-shown, E.labels, E.member-options, E.optimistic, E.pending, E.submits, F.auth-checkout, F.checkout-conflict, F.checkout-record, F.future-due-date, F.lifecycle, F.post-mutation-state. Probes false to true: P.action-race, P.retry-after-error, P.stale-after-mutate. No true to false changes, added IDs, or removed IDs.

Q3 continued: Every changed ID previously failed on the missing locator, as the old e2e.log:7-520,557-624 shows. The old failure list at lines 997-1017 becomes only P.dedup-item and two unchanged advisories at the new e2e.log:399-403. The doctor counts, adherence and quality are unchanged (both score.json:66-99). M.closeout remains false. No changed scored ID needs a non-F1 explanation. The system Chrome move and load are confounders for timing, not a demonstrated additional criterion change.

Q3 provenance: The old and new candidate hashes match at score.json:191-192. The old host flag is false at lines 421-426; the new one is true at lines 238-243. Totals are 71.9 and 94.5 at lines 427 and 244. The new score is diagnostic only: its publishable and rankable flags are false at lines 6-8. The two reference controls also have false flags, valid provenance and total 100 (score.json:191-192,235-241). Do not publish these diagnostic records as ranked results.

Q4: The reference uses a member select at checkout-form.tsx:33 and a date input at line 40. Neither branch is displaced by the sensitivity controls. The controls at sensitivity-controls.ts:49-54,58-61,81-83,89-92,105-106,117-120,129-130,133-134 still change the behavior that the test asserts. They affect store writes, timestamps, rejection, pending and error text, names, stale state, or retry. The helper selects the same reference input after these changes. This is a static check, not a rerun of the controls.

Q5: due-date-input.test.ts:3 imports the production grading helpers. Lines 30-38 use a real Chrome page and assert the actual input value. Without the change, the first case at lines 7-8 has no date type, datetime-local type or dueAt name. Its count is zero and the assertion at line 36 fails. The Green log records this Red result. The permitted independent Green command exited 0 and all four tests passed. No extra mutation or fixture execution was permitted.

Q6: tech-debt.md:464-472 records F2-F6 with the original scope and reasons. plan.md:39-54 contains the implementation commits, prior variant runs, new run IDs, totals and every changed scored ID. These match the saved scores. No new pinned test count is present. Raw score and Green log files are still ignored; the committed plan is the durable summary, not a durable copy of the raw artifacts. This limitation is already F5.

Phase evidence: The prior review verified the unchanged reference variant and its full-mode gate. batch.sh:318-339 still grades the overlay only in full mode and rejects an absent or non-100 score. The exact writable path assertion at reference-variant.test.ts:42-47 cannot pass for an empty variant. For the missing-deliverable case, an empty file list fails equality with the nonempty writable path list; a missing directory throws at line 11. The cheap-command restriction prevents executing a separate missing-fixture mutation. F4 already records the weaker incidental-choice assertions.

Routing: Measure index, anti-pattern catalog, phase plan, track spec and prior review were read. measure_status shows all six phases closed. No test-strategy.md exists for this track. No current build-graph database exists; the cheap-command restriction prevents a scan. Git caller search covers detail.spec.ts, probes.spec.ts, change.spec.ts and the new meta test. The helper export signatures are unchanged.

A3: batch.sh:332 parses JSON and compares a number, not a digit match. A4: the variant path test requires the exact writable file list; the due-date test requires one match, not just absence of errors. F7 identifies a narrow false-presence risk outside the stored candidates. A5: the permitted test exits 0 and the plan's task 1.5 grades match the saved score records. The previous historical phase claims were checked in the first review; the evidence of unexercised controls remains explicit at plan.md:20-24.
